title: Recolored Ad Astra Mars and Venus
description: Recolors the textures of Ad Astra's Mars and Venus' blocks to be somewhat more accurate to real life.
body:
# Recolored Ad Astra Mars and Venus
This resource pack aims to recolor Ad Astra's Mars and Venus blocks to be somewhat more accurate to real life-- Mars is redder, and Venus is a dark grayish black.

You can check the gallery for comparison screenshots!
